thread:
maya (support): Hey team, customer acme-infra opened an escalation — intermittent SSE streams from our text-generation endpoint. They report: frequent disconnects after ~30s, sometimes partial chunked outputs, and occasionally a 402 billing error mid-stream. Can someone triage? :eyes:

carlos (cs): Customer says they saw it across two regions (us-west1 & eu-west1). They gave us client logs and a repro script. Repro indicates streams start fine then stop emitting events, EventSource fires onerror and then reconnects but often gets no more events — sometimes the server responds with 402 on reconnect.

maya (support): Pasting their minimal repro JS snippet:```\nconst es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=x');\nes.onmessage = e => console.log('msg', e.data);\nes.onerror = e => console.log('err', e);\n```\nThey also added a curl stream:```\ncurl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=x\n```\nLast lines show connection reset and then a 402 response on re-connect.

dan (eng-sre): Thanks — initial hunch: two overlapping issues: 1) upstream proxy or load-balancer idle timeout dropping TCP after ~30s; 2) token expiry or billing check happening at reconnection causing 402. Need logs from runtime for that client's token id. @rohit can you look at request traces for thread_ts=1834567890?

rohit (eng-runtime): Pulling traces now. I can see conn established -> keepalive packets not sent by our nginx proxy due to default proxy_send_timeout. After ~28s, proxy closes socket with RESET. Our runtime logs show stream worker still running and attempted to write; write fails with EPIPE. On client reconnect we validate billing/account state; looks like billing service had a transient glitch and returned 'unpaid' for ~10s leading to 402 on the reconnect path. So both are real.

akira (eng-ml): For partial outputs: since we flush tokens as we generate, a dropped connection will leave the user with whatever arrived. We do not currently support resume/last-event-id to continue from last token. Implementing partial resume is non-trivial for deterministic token alignment. Suggest focus on keeping connections alive and avoiding premature closes.

evelyn (product): OK. Prioritize reliability fixes first. Propose short-term: add application-level SSE comment pings (":\n") every 15s and adjust nginx/lightweight proxies to use TCP keepalive shorter than 20s where possible. Long-term: server-side token refresh + idempotent reconnection flow + explicit Last-Event-Id support for best-effort resume.

maya (support): Customer asked whether they should change client code. What do we recommend?

rohit (eng-runtime): For clients: use EventSource polyfill that reconnects with exponential backoff and retries Authorization header on reconnect; ensure your network path doesn't terminate idle HTTP/1.1 streams (some corporate proxies do). Recommend adding client-side app-level pings: server will send ": ping\n\n" comments, and clients should treat comments as keepalive if they can. Example server ping format: ```\n: keepalive\n\n``` If they can't rely on that, browsers' EventSource automatically handles it but some middleboxes ignore data and still drop. For CURL based troubleshooting, run with `--no-buffer` and keep output streaming.

carlos (cs): The customer also mentioned tokens rotate every 30s in their infra (internal). Could cause reauth on reconnect. They might be reusing a stale token.

maya (support): I asked them to enable debug logs and share request headers on reconnect.

ops-bot: deploy:nginx-proxy v2.14 deployed to staging at 2026-03-15T10:12:00Z by dan.

dan (eng-sre): On infra side I propose immediate mitigation: 1) bump proxy idle timeouts to 90s for streaming routes, 2) enable TCP keepalive on LB with interval 10s, 3) introduce server-side SSE comment ping every 12s. I'll roll these to prod in a controlled window.

rohit (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: We already have a channel for SSE ping generation in runtime. Hooking a lightweight comment ping every N seconds is cheap — will gate by route config. Also add a metric 'sse.ping_sent' and 'sse.conn_closed_reset' so we can correlate. For billing 402 we should make billing check tolerant to short transient errors during reconnect: fallback to cached bill state for e.g., 60s. I'll add a short cache TTL and circuit-breaker around billing calls.

akira (eng-ml): Add test harness in ci: spin up an nginx with proxy_send_timeout=30s and run EventSource client for 5 minutes to confirm pings prevent resets. Also test partial outputs correctness when stream interrupted.

evelyn (product): Prioritize rollout order: staging -> limited prod -> all prod. Communicate to customers about a brief maintenance window if needed. Also add doc to support KB about 'SSE best practices' covering: comment pings, client reconnection strategies, token handling, and proxy timeouts.

maya (support): I created a repro ticket for customer with steps and asked them to test the staging endpoint. Shared staging URL and asked for headers and response bodies if they still see 402 on reconnect.

carlos (cs): Customer response: they tried staging, pings fixed disconnects for them in us-west1, but in eu-west1 they still saw 402 on reconnect — likely billing cache not yet deployed.

rohit (eng-runtime): Deploying billing cache rule now to staging (feature flag sse-billing-cache). Will monitor. Also logging added for auth failures with token id and trace-id to tie back to customer logs.

maya (support): Anything for developers to be aware of?

dan (eng-sre): Note: if you're using our private deployment (VPC/on-prem) you may still hit corporate proxies that kill idle streams aggressively. Recommend local network teams either allow long-lived HTTP connections or use client-initiated polling over websockets as fallback. Also set kernel TCP keepalive options if you manage LB.

rohit (eng-runtime): Quick reproduction steps we used (for internal use):```\n# run nginx with proxy_send_timeout 30s\ndocker run -p 8080:80 -v $(pwd)/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf nginx\n# run simple eventsource client\nnode repro-client.js\n# observe if server comment pings arrive every 12s, connection persists\n```

maya (support): I'm going to draft support KB and post it in #docs once we have the final config values.

evelyn (product): Outcome summary: short-term mitigations (proxy timeout bump, TCP keepalive, server pings) fixed disconnects in staging and for most customers. Medium-term: billing call caching and better reconnect auth flows to eliminate 402 on reconnects. Long-term: consider Last-Event-Id support and resumable-stream semantics.

rohit (eng-runtime): Follow-up: I'll open PRs for ping toggles and billing cache. Dan will rollout LB settings. Please monitor metrics and set alerts for spikes in sse.conn_closed_reset and billing.reconnect_402.

maya (support): Thanks everyone — marking this thread resolved for now, will reopen if customer sees further issues. :white_check_mark:\"
